description: This file declares functions for CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) computations, including calc_crc, crc32, and crc32inc, and defines a type alias crc_t. It is intended for inclusion in C/C++ projects and provides external function declarations related to CRC calculations.

methods.name: calc_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC over a message array of bytes.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Computes CRC32 checksum for a given buffer.

methods.name: crc32inc
methods.description: Incrementally computes CRC32 checksum given a buffer and a prior CRC value.
